award_lead: And look at these, dear - the court has achievements to celebrate:
intro: The Grandmother presiding, dear. {count} screenshots! Well. Somebody has been keeping wonderful records, and this court could not be prouder.
name: The Grandmother

sentences.Felony-Level Archivist: Encouragement: an archive this size takes dedication, dear. Museums have been founded on less. The court will put it on the refrigerator.
sentences.Habitual Hoarder: Encouragement: a healthy, hearty collection. Every screenshot is a memory somebody loved enough to keep, and this court refuses to call that a crime.
sentences.Innocent Bystander: Sentence: case dismissed, sweetheart. Such a tidy little folder. The court insists you take a cookie and screenshot the recipe.
sentences.Petty Offender: Sentence: a tiny fine of one deleted duplicate, dear, and only if you were going to anyway. There is no rush. There is never any rush.
sentences.Repeat Offender: Sentence: probation, which in this court means the folder gets a nice compliment once a month. It has been working so hard.
sentences.Unrepentant Screenshot Felon: Encouragement: none needed. A life, fully documented, down to the last boarding pass. Your grandmother is showing this folder to her friends.
